title: Test that a control-host open refuses at SQLite's locking-protocol error once its call allowance is spent
outcome: Test that a control-host open refuses at SQLite's locking-protocol error once its call allowance is spent
acceptance: A behaviour test opens a store for a control host inside a call whose allowance is already spent, injects SQLite's locking-protocol refusal, and shows the open returns the busy refusal without starting again
